text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce crosses the finish line in 
first place! The final leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho, has been 
claimed by Royce and Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah......... Huh, me――?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Without a shadow of a doubt, the 
victory is yours.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"To think that I was really... so absorbed 
that I don't remember a single thing."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is won by the strongest 
Umamusume... Not only does the long 
distance test overall ability, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You also need the mental fortitude to 
maintain your concentration. I see...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was able to realize what I lacked. You 
have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! To receive your recognition...! It's an 
honor...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —However! Next time... I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I won't back down either!

A tremendous wave of cheers and applause 
naturally erupted. The grandstands were 
filled with a refreshing, uplifting 
atmosphere.

And then, the Winning Live. Bathed in the 
spotlight, Royce and Royce's smile shone 
brighter than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for the support--! To show 
my gratitude, I'm gonna hype this up with 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ticket-saaan! Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hayahide-san...! Today was really—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In praise of your valiant effort.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Taishin-san, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're super close! That's sooooo 
emotional~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Man... talk about youth!!

On the way back, Royce and Royce seemed 
utterly ungrounded, as if her excitement 
still hadn't faded in the slightest.
choice_data_list: The youthful route was a huge success!

The youthful route was a huge success, 
wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Self-producing!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Riding on the friendship of 
BNW, we'll live our youth to the—

Partway through, I had a feeling that 
might happen. She was having genuine fun 
with BNW, getting fiercely passionate 
about it.
choice_data_list: Watching you all reminds me of my youth.
Watching you all reminds me of my youth.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Really...? Well then, all's well that 
ends well, I suppose?"
choice_data_list: Yeah. I think it's fine to stay like this!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For you to emphasize it that much, 
Trainer. Fufu, you truly mean it, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"The media coverage that used to be all 
about BNW has finally started including me 
as well."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm being treated on equal footing with 
Hayahide-san and the others now!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take this relationship even further 
and step onto the next stage in the Senior 
Year!"
choice_data_list:
Then how about making the Osaka Hai our 
next goal?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A classic Senior Year spring 
medium-distance race. Umamusume from older 
generations will probably run too, so it 
should leave a fresh impression!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We haven't scouted the older generation 
much yet, but let's develop a plan step by 
step!
